topic.angle: The pilgrimage that reached the wider Muslim world

card.title: The king who gave gold away

panels.text: Mali, 1324. Mansa Musa sets out on the hajj, the pilgrimage to Mecca, travelling with an enormous entourage and a vast supply of gold.
On the way he spends time in Cairo.
His lavish gift-giving there is said to have noticeably affected the value of gold in Egypt, and it garnered the attention of the wider Muslim world.
Back home, Musa expanded the borders of the Mali Empire, incorporating the cities of Gao and Timbuktu, and helped establish Timbuktu as a center of Islamic learning.

probes.question: In which city did Mansa Musa spend time on his hajj, where his gift-giving is said to have affected the value of gold?
